stacks.note: Sony SequenceImageNumber splits two bursts inside the same second; ReleaseMode2=2 marks a bracket without EV data

a7iii.note: α7 III records whole seconds: 10-frame burst, then a frame 1 s later with dHash distance ≥ 28 stays its own stack

split.note: cuts[id]='row' splits a row with reason 'you split here'; 'join' merges

afterBurst.note: a 10-frame burst followed by singles 20 s apart stays one row

moves.note: drag tiles onto a row header / between rows / onto a stack

stackMerge.note: a bracket frame dropped onto a burst joins it

peak.note: 9-frame burst; consecutive dHash distances 2,2,2,2,12,2,2,2 → peak on frame 5

twoBody.note: two bodies, same second: sorted by serial, then file number
